	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from

	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @TipoMembresiaFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		TipoMembresia_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @TipoMembresiaFilter (TipoMembresia_Id)
		SELECT 
			[TipoMembresia].Id
		FROM [dbo].[TipoMembresia]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[TipoMembresia].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @TipoMembresiaFilter (TipoMembresia_Id)
		SELECT 
			[TipoMembresia].Id
		FROM [dbo].[TipoMembresia]
		WHERE
			 [TipoMembresia].[Activo] = 1 AND
         (([TipoMembresia].[ConceptoFacturable_Id] = @ConceptoFacturable_Id) OR (@ConceptoFacturable_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[TipoMembresia].[Id],
		[TipoMembresia].[Nombre],
		[ConceptoFacturable].[Concepto] AS [ConceptoMensual],		
		[TipoMembresia].[Activo],
		[TipoMembresia].[FechaDesactivacion],
		[TipoMembresia].[DesactivadoPor],		
		
		[TipoMembresia].[FechaCreacion],
		[TipoMembresia].[CreadoPor],
		[TipoMembresia].[FechaModificacion],
		[TipoMembresia].[ModificadoPor]
	FROM @TipoMembresiaFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[TipoMembresia] 
			ON [TipoMembresia].[Id] = filter.[TipoMembresia_Id] 
			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable]
		ON [dbo].[TipoMembresia].[ConceptoFacturable_Id] = [dbo].[ConceptoFacturable].[Id] 

 
END
